sql_query:
SELECT
  LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  (ABS((oi.shipping_limit_date::date - o.order_purchase_timestamp::date)))::INT AS shipping_limit_days,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.shipping_limit_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
